intro: Thyme brings warmth to small dining spaces. With its marble-look top, maple-toned frame, and cushioned beige chairs, it turns everyday meals into cozy rituals where style and comfort meet effortlessly.

features.title: Maple-toned frame with beige accents
features.text: The warm maple shade pairs beautifully with beige seating, giving your dining area a timeless, versatile aesthetic.

features.title: Elegant marble-inspired top
features.text: An MDF top with PVC membrane finish gives the table a sleek marble look, combining visual appeal with a surface that’s easy to care for.

features.title: Strong and stable rubberwood frame
features.text: Crafted with a rubberwood understructure, the table offers lasting durability and strength, supporting up to 80 kg with ease.

features.title: Comfortable chairs with cushioned seats
features.text: Polyester-upholstered seats with 28 kg/m³ foam density provide support and softness, letting you linger longer at the table.

features.title: Safe rounded edges for family use
features.text: Rounded table edges keep the setup safer for families with kids, making meals stress-free without compromising on style.

features.title: Angular legs for more legroom
features.text: Legs placed at the table ends enhance leg space and comfort, allowing diners to move freely without feeling cramped.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Thyme Rectangular 4-Seater Solid Wood Dining Set
